**History of Life and Death.** **227**

<margin>04</margin>
we shall inquire; for the proper
work of Cold is *Condensation*; and
it is perfected without any 
malignity, or hostile quality:
and therefore the operation is safer,
than through *Opiates*; although a little less
powerful, if it were used only by turns,
just as *Opiates* are used: But again, because it can be 
applied familiarly, and in daily diet
in moderation, it is also
far more powerful for the prolonga-
tion of life, than through *Opiates*.

<margin>39</margin>
*The Refrigeration of the Spirits*, is done in three
ways; Either by *Respiration*;
Or by *Vapors*; Or by *Food*:
The first is best, but almost
outside our power; The second is also
powerful, and yet it is at hand;
The third is weak and works through circuits.

Air

<summary>This passage discusses the cooling of the vital spirits as a method for life extension, arguing that cold-based condensation is safer than the use of opiates and identifying respiration, vapors, and diet as the primary means of achieving this refrigeration.</summary>
